questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Separating two core losses from two readings
questions.learningObjective: Separate hysteresis and eddy loss from two frequency readings
questions.stem: At 50 Hz total loss 10 W; at 100 Hz total loss 30 W. Assuming hysteresis linear and eddy quadratic in f, find hysteresis loss at 50 Hz.
questions.explanation: Let h = hysteresis at 50, e = eddy at 50. h+e=10; 2h+4e=30. Solve: from first e=10-h; 2h+4(10-h)=30 => 2h+40-4h=30 => -2h=-10 => h=5? Wait compute: 2h+40-4h=30 => -2h=-10 => h=5. Then e=5. Check at 100: 2*5+4*5=30. So h=5. Report 5.
